title: feat: decrement stock
defect: SKU stock is read into a Python int then written back so two cashiers oversell SKU-441
reach: flash sale opens two POS terminals on the same SKU
missing: two concurrent checkouts cannot drive stock negative
fix: UPDATE inventory SET stock = stock - %s WHERE sku=%s AND stock >= %s and assert rowcount==1 (Django F('stock')-qty)

title: feat: wallet read cache
defect: Session expire_on_commit=False so a credited wallet is re-read stale and the next debit overdrafts
reach: payout worker and debit API share one long-lived Session
missing: after another transaction credits, this session must not debit the pre-credit balance
fix: expire_on_commit=True or session.expire(wallet) after any external credit before debit

title: feat: signup lookup
defect: findUnique({email}) then create() without a unique retry so two signups of the same email 500 after the first commit
reach: mobile and web submit the same email in the same second
missing: concurrent identical emails must surface Unique constraint, not a 500 on the second create
fix: create inside try/catch P2002 or upsert on email; do not TOCTOU findUnique then create

title: feat: restore account
defect: UniqueConstraint(email, condition=Q(deleted_at=None)) plus undelete vs signup: both pass the predicate and two live rows share the email
reach: support undelete and self-serve signup race on the same address
missing: undelete concurrent with signup must fail one side on the partial unique
fix: undelete via UPDATE ... WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS live email, or advisory lock on email

title: feat: restore member
defect: paranoid restore() of a soft-deleted email races create() of the same email and both rows become live
reach: admin restore and invite-accept hit the same unique email
missing: restore vs create of one email must leave exactly one non-deleted row
fix: restore inside a transaction that locks the unique index or use a live-email exclusion

title: feat: org slug
defect: validate_unique(:slug) without unique_constraint so two orgs insert the same slug and the second raises a raw PG error after the HTTP 201 path
reach: two founders type the same slug on the welcome form
missing: duplicate slug must become a changeset error, not a 500 after insert
fix: add unique_constraint(:slug) and a unique index; do not treat validate_unique as sufficient

title: feat: refund save
defect: gorm Save(&Refund{Amount:0}) skips the zero Amount so a full refund is a no-op and the capture stays charged
reach: support issues a zero-remainder full refund after a prior partial
missing: Amount==0 must persist as a full refund of remaining capture
fix: use Select("Amount") or Updates(map) so zero values are written; do not Save a zero struct

title: feat: mark paid
defect: Order.update_all(status: 'paid') skips after_commit so Elasticsearch still serves unpaid and finance double-collects
missing: after update_all, search must not return those orders as unpaid
fix: use update! in a job that runs callbacks, or enqueue an explicit index rebuild keyed by id

title: feat: native adjust
defect: createNativeQuery UPDATE credits the row then entity.setNote(save) dirty-writes the pre-update amount back
reach: adjust endpoint runs SQL then saves a loaded entity for an audit note
missing: native credit plus later entity save must not restore the pre-credit amount
fix: session.refresh(entity) after native UPDATE, or persist the note with a separate UPDATE of note only

title: feat: receipt email
defect: send_receipt() is called before transaction.atomic returns and the process dies after SMTP but before COMMIT so the user has a receipt and no order
reach: checkout worker is OOM-killed during SMTP
missing: receipt must not be sent unless the order row is committed
fix: transaction.on_commit(send_receipt) on the same connection as the INSERT

title: feat: profile merge
defect: session.merge(User(id=uid, name=form)) without version_id clobbers a concurrent email change on the same pk
reach: settings name save races a verified-email write
missing: merge of name must not overwrite a newer email column
fix: load + attribute assign of only submitted fields, or merge with version_id WHERE version=

title: feat: book room
defect: no EXCLUDE USING gist (room_id WITH =, during WITH &&) so two bookings overlap 14:00-15:00 on room 12
reach: two coordinators click the same slot
missing: overlapping tstzrange on one room_id must be rejected by the database
fix: ALTER TABLE booking ADD EXCLUDE USING gist (room_id WITH =, during WITH &&)

title: feat: citext email
defect: UNIQUE on citext(email) does not NFC-normalize so cafe\u0301@x and café@x both insert as distinct owners
reach: attacker registers the NFD form of an existing member email
missing: NFC and NFD forms of the same email must collide on the unique index
fix: store normalize('NFC', lower(email)) in a generated column and unique that

title: feat: global sku
defect: UNIQUE(tenant_id, sku) treats NULL tenant_id as distinct so two 'global' SKUs of the same code coexist and billing double-charges
reach: platform SKUs are inserted with tenant_id NULL
missing: two rows with tenant_id IS NULL and the same sku must violate unique
fix: UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT (tenant_id, sku) on PG15+ or a sentinel tenant

title: feat: vendor payout
defect: SUM(amount::float8) for vendor payout drifts (0.1+0.2) so the last vendor is underpaid by a cent that finance cannot reconcile
missing: payout total must equal SUM of numeric(12,2) line amounts with no binary float
fix: SUM(amount::numeric(12,2)) and pay that; never float8 money

title: feat: invoice items
defect: prefetch_related('items') then items.create(); later iterate uses the prefetch cache and the new line is missing so the invoice total is short
reach: add-line API creates then immediately serializes the invoice
missing: create after prefetch must be visible on the next iterate or the cache must be cleared
fix: invoice.items.add with cache.clear() or re-fetch items after create before totaling

title: feat: adjust amount
defect: session.execute UPDATE amount then instance.save() writes the expired-in-memory amount back over the SQL credit
reach: adjust endpoint updates via text() then saves an audit field on the same instance
missing: SQL UPDATE of amount plus later instance save must keep the SQL amount
fix: session.expire(instance, ['amount']) after execute, or UPDATE only the audit column

title: feat: status only
defect: Order.objects.only('status').get(); obj.status='shipped'; obj.save() NULLs amount and tax because deferred fields are treated as unset
reach: ops ships an order from a status-only queryset
missing: save after only('status') must not write NULL to amount or tax
fix: save(update_fields=['status']) or do not use only() on a writable instance

title: feat: charge task
defect: acks_late=False so a worker death after stripe.Charge.create and before return acks the message and fulfillment never runs
reach: worker OOM after the charge call
missing: death after charge must redeliver until fulfillment commits
fix: acks_late=True and idempotent charge key; do not ack before fulfillment

title: feat: jetstream consumer
defect: js.ack() then db.insert(order); crash between them drops the message and the order is never written
missing: ack must happen after the order row commits
fix: insert in a txn then ack; on crash the message redelivers and insert is idempotent on event id

title: feat: monthly usage
defect: INCR month:usage never EXPIRE so November starts at October's 40k and the tenant is overbilled
reach: month rollover job only INCR, never rotate the key
missing: a new calendar month must start usage at 0
fix: key includes YYYY-MM and SET EXPIRE at month end, or GETDEL on rollover

title: feat: webhook order
defect: handlers process by event.created not event.id so an older charge.succeeded replay after refund.created double-ships
reach: Stripe retries an old event after a refund already shipped the inverse
missing: replay of an older event.id must be ignored once a newer event for the same object is applied
fix: store processed event ids and object version; do not order solely by created

title: feat: lock order
defect: select_for_update() on Order.objects.select_related('user') locks the users row and leaves the order unlocked so two captures succeed
reach: two capture workers join user for email
missing: FOR UPDATE must lock the order row, not only the joined user
fix: select_for_update(of=('self',)) on Django 4.2+ or lock Order without the join

title: feat: allocate qty
defect: READ COMMITTED SELECT SUM(qty) misses an in-flight insert so two allocators hand out more than on-hand
reach: two warehouses allocate the same SKU
missing: concurrent insert of a reservation must be visible to SUM or the allocator must lock the SKU row
fix: lock SKU then SUM, or SERIALIZABLE / next-key lock on the reservation range

title: feat: book slot
defect: naive America/New_York local times store both 01:30 EST and 01:30 EDT as the same wall clock so two patients occupy one chair
reach: fall-back night booking UI shows 01:30 twice
missing: the two fold-hour 01:30 instants must be distinct timestamptz rows
fix: store timestamptz UTC; never unique on naive local wall time in a fold

title: feat: session cutoff
defect: datetime.fromtimestamp(exp) uses the app server local TZ so a UTC epoch cutoff is five hours late and stolen cookies stay valid
reach: API boxes run America/Chicago, tokens issued in UTC epoch seconds
missing: expiry must be compared in UTC, not the box local zone
fix: datetime.fromtimestamp(exp, tz=timezone.utc) or compare raw epoch ints

title: feat: exp compare
defect: expires_at is unix milliseconds compared to time.time() seconds so every session looks ~1.7e12 seconds in the future and never dies
reach: mobile ships exp in ms, API compares to time.time()
missing: a token with exp=now_ms+3600000 must expire after one hour, not stay valid for millennia
fix: normalize units on one side (ms/1000 or s*1000) with an explicit test

title: feat: comment render
defect: {{{comment}}} triple-stashes user HTML so a stored <script> in a product review executes in other shoppers
reach: reviews are rendered with mustache on the PDP
missing: angle brackets in a review must render as text, not execute
fix: use {{comment}} escaped; never triple-stash untrusted review HTML

title: feat: cms body
defect: v-html="cms.body" renders merchant-supplied HTML so a compromised merchant account XSS the storefront
reach: CMS pages are Vue-rendered for every visitor
missing: merchant HTML must pass a sanitizer before v-html, or not use v-html
fix: DOMPurify.sanitize(cms.body) with a tight allowlist, or compile to safe nodes

title: feat: review card
defect: unsafeHTML(review.body) in a Lit shop card executes a stored payload from a verified-buyer review
reach: review cards are Lit components on the PDP
missing: review HTML must not execute script when interpolated
fix: plain-text content or sanitize before unsafeHTML; default to textContent

title: feat: bio helper
defect: new Handlebars.SafeString(user.bio) marks attacker HTML safe so the profile page executes it
reach: profile bios render through a custom helper
missing: user.bio must be escaped by default Handlebars, not wrapped SafeString
fix: return the string unwrapped so Handlebars escapes; never SafeString untrusted input

title: feat: note partial
defect: p!= user.note unescapes a support note so a ticket from the customer XSS the agent inbox
reach: inbox renders customer notes with Pug
missing: customer notes must escape HTML
fix: use p= user.note (escaped); never != for untrusted notes

title: feat: review snippet
defect: th:utext="${review}" inserts raw HTML from a marketplace review into the seller dashboard
missing: review text must use th:text, not utext
fix: th:text="${review}" or an HTML sanitizer before utext

title: feat: read upload
defect: os.lstat(path) then open(path) allows a symlink swap to /etc/passwd between the two syscalls so a tenant download returns host secrets
reach: upload dir is on a shared volume the tenant can rename into
missing: open must refuse a path that became a symlink after lstat
fix: open with O_NOFOLLOW (or fd from openat) and fstat the fd; do not re-open by path

title: feat: promote tmp
defect: os.rename(tmp, dest) overwrites dest after dest was replaced with a symlink to another tenant object
reach: two promotes target the same public name
missing: promote must fail if dest already exists as a different inode
fix: os.replace is still overwrite; use os.rename with RENAME_NOREPLACE / link+unlink

title: feat: copy object
defect: shutil.copy2(src, dest) then dest is a symlink into secrets so the copy clobbers host credentials
reach: tenant-controlled dest path in a shared prefix
missing: copy must not follow a dest symlink into /var/run/secrets
fix: open dest with O_NOFOLLOW|O_EXCL or copy into a private dir then rename

title: feat: lock ledger
defect: fcntl LOCK_EX on a fd that logging.FileHandler later dups and closes, dropping the lock so two writers append a split JSON line
reach: structlog adds a FileHandler on the same ledger path
missing: closing a dup fd must not release the lock the writer still holds
fix: lock a dedicated fd that no logger owns, or flock on a separate .lock file

title: feat: ensure dir
defect: Path.mkdir(exist_ok=True) then chmod(0o777) leaves a window where another uid drops a file the service later treats as its own
reach: two services ensure the same spool dir
missing: mkdir must create with the final mode atomically and refuse a pre-existing foreign dir
fix: os.mkdir(mode=0o750) without exist_ok, or mkdir+fchmod on the dir fd

title: feat: stream blob
defect: stat then sendfile(path) after the tenant unlinks and replaces the name so the client is streamed another tenant's invoice
reach: blob names are reused after delete
missing: sendfile must stream the inode that passed auth, not a replaced name
fix: open fd at auth time and sendfile the fd; never re-resolve the path

title: feat: migrate plans
defect: alembic data UPDATE users.plan with no lock while the app dual-writes old and new enums so a row is left on a retired plan the billing job cannot price
reach: expand/contract deploy runs the data migration live
missing: every user.plan must be a live enum value when the migration returns
fix: UPDATE ... WHERE id IN (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE) in batches, or take an advisory lock the app honors

title: feat: backfill phones
defect: RunPython(backfill, atomic=False) writes half the phones then dies so later unique(phone) migrations fail on NULLs mixed with new writes
reach: backfill is run in production against 2M rows
missing: a failed backfill must not leave a prefix of rows committed
fix: atomic=True (default) or batch in explicit atomic blocks with a resume key

title: feat: repeatable view
defect: R__order_view.sql checksum differs on two replicas so one shop has a view missing discount_cents and invoices undercharge
reach: blue/green each apply their working-tree copy
missing: both replicas must have the same view definition including discount_cents
fix: pin the repeatable checksum in CI and refuse apply on drift; do not edit R__ out of band

title: feat: patch kyc
defect: row.data = row.data || patch without a version so a later address patch wipes a concurrent KYC document key
reach: address form and KYC webhook patch the same jsonb
missing: two patches of distinct keys must both survive
fix: jsonb_set per key or optimistic version on data; do not replace the whole object from a stale read

title: feat: profile save
defect: find() then doc.visits++; doc.save() clobbers a concurrent $inc on credits so a purchased credit pack disappears
reach: pageview counter save races a credit webhook
missing: save of visits must not reset credits incremented elsewhere
fix: use updateOne $inc for visits; never find-modify-save a whole document

title: feat: es inventory
defect: update ignores version_conflict_engine_exception so last write wins and a sold-out SKU is still searchable as in stock
reach: two indexers update the same SKU doc
missing: a version conflict must retry with the latest seq_no, not overwrite
fix: if_seq_no/if_primary_term and retry on 409; do not ignore version_conflict

title: feat: mark paid iter
defect: iterator() over unpaid, save() paid mid-loop, PostgreSQL keyset cursor skips the next unpaid so those orders never settle
reach: nightly settlement walks unpaid with iterator(chunk_size=200)
missing: mutating the filter key under iterator must not skip unpaid rows
fix: iterate ids first into a list, or use a side table of work ids

title: feat: yield debit
defect: yield_per(100) without expire_on_commit writes stale loaded objects after a concurrent credit, overdrafting the wallet
reach: debit job streams wallets with yield_per
missing: a wallet credited after load must not be debited from the stale amount
fix: expire_all() per chunk or lock each wallet before debit

title: feat: batch close
defect: FindInBatches then Save changes the sort key so the next batch skips orders and they stay open past SLA
reach: closer updates status which is the ORDER BY
missing: mutating the batch order key must not drop later rows
fix: batch on immutable id > last_id, not on the column you update

title: feat: bulk reserve
defect: bulk_create(..., ignore_conflicts=True) returns objs with pk=None so later FK inserts 500 and the reservation is silent-lost
reach: flash-sale reserve tries to insert already-held SKUs
missing: ignored conflicts must be detected and not treated as inserted rows with pks
fix: bulk_create without ignore, or INSERT ... ON CONFLICT RETURNING and check returned ids

title: feat: insert hold
defect: insert().on_conflict_do_nothing() without returning so the caller thinks a hold row exists and decrements stock with no hold
reach: two tabs hold the same SKU
missing: DO NOTHING must be visible to the caller as not-inserted
fix: RETURNING id and treat empty returning as conflict, or ON CONFLICT UPDATE a token

title: feat: createMany holds
defect: createMany({skipDuplicates:true}) silent-skips so inventory reservation is missing while the UI shows held
reach: client retries createMany after a timeout
missing: skipped duplicates must not be counted as reserved
fix: create one-by-one with P2002 handling, or count inserted vs requested

title: feat: get or create tag
defect: get_or_create(name=) without a unique on name so two requests create two Tag rows and products attach at random
reach: import job and UI add the same tag
missing: get_or_create on name must be backed by UNIQUE(name)
fix: add unique=True on name; catch IntegrityError and re-get

title: feat: nested save
defect: begin_nested(); except IntegrityError: pass leaves the session invalid so a later commit writes nothing and the API still returns 201
reach: signup retries after a unique collision inside a savepoint
missing: IntegrityError in a nested txn must expire/rollback the session before any later commit
fix: rollback the nested txn and session.rollback() or raise; do not pass

title: feat: transfer
defect: debit then credit without peewee atomic() so a crash after debit drops the credit and money vanishes
missing: debit and credit must commit together or not at all
fix: with database.atomic(): debit(); credit()

title: feat: add check
defect: ADD CONSTRAINT balance_nonneg CHECK (balance >= 0) NOT VALID and VALIDATE is never run so existing negative balances stay and new ones sneak via the still-NOT VALID path in this migration chain
reach: expand/contract adds the check ahead of a backfill that never ships
missing: after the migration, no row may have balance < 0 and new writes must be checked
fix: VALIDATE CONSTRAINT in the same release or do not claim the check is live

title: feat: bulk import
defect: SET session_replication_role = replica disables the audit trigger so a bulk import of payouts leaves no audit rows finance requires
reach: ops import uses replica role to skip slow triggers
missing: payout inserts must still write audit_log rows
fix: do not set session_replication_role in app code; batch with the trigger on or write audit explicitly

title: feat: support read
defect: table owner bypasses RLS so SET ROLE support_owner in the support console returns every tenant's invoices
reach: support role owns the invoices table
missing: support reads must still be constrained by tenant RLS
fix: FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY on the table and do not use the owner role for app queries

title: feat: order lines
defect: through table OrderLine has no unique(order_id, sku) so two clicks add two lines and the customer is charged twice for one SKU
missing: one (order, sku) pair must exist once
fix: UniqueConstraint(['order', 'sku']) on the through model

title: feat: comment count
defect: post.comments_count += 1; post.save() loses increments under concurrency so the badge shows 3 and there are 7 comments
missing: each insert must increment the cache exactly once
fix: F('comments_count')+1 or a DB trigger; do not read-modify-write the integer

title: feat: version bump
defect: doc.version += 1 in Python without WHERE version=old so two editors both commit and the first body is silently replaced
reach: two tabs save the same doc
missing: the second save must fail on version mismatch
fix: UPDATE ... SET body=%s, version=version+1 WHERE id=%s AND version=%s and check rowcount

title: feat: json patch
defect: PATCH ignores If-Match W/"v1" so a stale client overwrites a newer JSON document
missing: a mismatched If-Match must 412, not apply
fix: compare strong or weak ETag and return 412 on mismatch before apply

title: feat: lww merge
defect: last-write-wins uses time.time() with millisecond ties so one of two equal-timestamp writes is dropped and a toggle never arrives
reach: two offline clients sync the same second
missing: equal timestamps must not drop a write; use a tie-break (site id, counter)
fix: LWW tuple (ts, site_id) unique per write; do not compare float time.time() alone

title: feat: workflow start
defect: WorkflowIDReusePolicy AllowDuplicate lets a second Start reset a completed payout workflow and double-pays the vendor
reach: retry button starts the same workflow id after completion
missing: a completed payout workflow id must not be restartable into a new pay
fix: RejectDuplicate or AllowDuplicateFailedOnly; never AllowDuplicate on money workflows

title: feat: unique job
defect: unique lock is released in ensure before the DB commit so a second job starts and charges twice
reach: job ensure unlocks then the worker is killed before commit
missing: unlock must happen after COMMIT, or the lock TTL must cover the commit
fix: release the unique lock in after_commit, not ensure

title: feat: job id
defect: jobId reused after completion so a new payload is ignored and the second invoice never charges
reach: client retries with the same jobId and a new invoice id
missing: a new payload under a completed jobId must either fail or create a new job
fix: include invoice id in jobId, or removeOnComplete and refuse reuse without a new id

title: feat: extend visibility
defect: changeMessageVisibility fails and is ignored so a second worker receives the message and double-ships
missing: a visibility extend failure must not leave the message acquirable by another worker mid-ship
fix: fail the work and retry, or abort shipping if extend fails; do not ignore the error

title: feat: watch stock
defect: WATCH sku then except: UNWATCH before EXEC so the later EXEC is unwatched and two checkouts oversell
reach: error handler UNWATCHes then the success path still EXECs
missing: EXEC after an error-path UNWATCH must not mutate stock
fix: do not UNWATCH in a shared except if EXEC still runs; abort the pipeline

title: feat: request lock
defect: middleware always calls pg_advisory_unlock_all() so a nested payment lock from the view is released before COMMIT and a second request double-captures
reach: every request ends in the same middleware
missing: unlock_all must not drop locks the view still needs for the txn
fix: unlock only the keys this request acquired, after COMMIT, never unlock_all mid-request

title: feat: skip locked
defect: select_for_update(skip_locked=True) on every worker so a hot payment row is starved until the auth expires and the capture never happens
reach: many workers poll the same authorized charge
missing: a row that stays locked must still be captured before auth expiry, not skipped forever
fix: one worker must wait (no skip_locked) or use a queue; skip_locked is for cheap work not money capture

title: feat: durable off
defect: atomic(durable=False) around a Stripe charge so a crash after CHARGE and before durable flush leaves a charge with no local row
missing: a charge must not exist at Stripe without a durable local order
fix: atomic(durable=True) default, and charge inside on_commit or after the durable commit with idempotency

title: feat: autocommit
defect: session.autocommit = True so INSERT order commits then INSERT line fails and the order is headless
missing: header and lines must commit together
fix: remove autocommit; one session.begin() around both inserts

title: feat: interactive txn
defect: interactive transaction timeout fires; client treats it as committed and tells the user paid while the txn rolled back
missing: a timeout must be a failure, not a success
fix: on PrismaClientKnownRequestError P2028 treat as rollback; do not return 200

title: feat: delete user
defect: Charge.user FK on_delete=DO_NOTHING so deleting a user leaves charges that a retry job re-captures against a missing card
missing: deleting a user must not leave retryable charges
fix: PROTECT or cancel-and-SET_NULL with a terminal status before delete

title: feat: replace addrs
defect: Association.Replace deletes extra address rows without a tenant clause so another tenant's address with the same user_id numeric is deleted
reach: user ids are per-tenant sequences that collide
missing: Replace must scope DELETE to tenant_id
fix: manual delete+insert with WHERE tenant_id= or composite owner key

title: feat: tenant delete
defect: AuditLog.tenant FK CASCADE so deleting a tenant wipes evidence finance is legally required to keep
reach: tenant offboarding deletes the Tenant row
missing: audit rows must survive tenant delete
fix: on_delete=PROTECT or SET_NULL and offboard without deleting audit

title: feat: snowflake id
defect: machine clock steps back so the next snowflake id collides with a committed PK and the insert fails after the user saw 201
reach: NTP step-back on one API box
missing: clock rollback must not emit a duplicate snowflake
fix: refuse to emit when clock < last_ts, or use a sequence not wall clock

title: feat: ulid
defect: custom ULID uses only time.time() milliseconds so two events in the same ms share an id and the second overwrites the first
missing: two events in the same millisecond must get distinct ULIDs
fix: use cryptographically random 80-bit entropy as the spec requires

title: feat: ksuid
defect: KSUID payload uses local wall time so the DST fall-back hour reissues ids and events overwrite
missing: KSUID time component must be UTC, not local wall time
fix: use utcnow/time.time() UTC as the KSUID spec requires

title: feat: activate tz
defect: timezone.activate(user.tz) is not deactivated so the next request on the thread uses the previous tenant's zone and a cutoff fires 6 hours late
missing: timezone context must reset after each request
fix: timezone.deactivate() in finally, or timezone.override in a context manager

title: feat: eta charge
defect: eta=datetime.now() naive is interpreted as UTC by the broker so the job fires 5h late after a grace retry and the user is charged twice
reach: delayed capture uses eta in Chicago local naive
missing: eta must be timezone-aware UTC and the task must be idempotent
fix: eta=datetime.now(timezone.utc) and an idempotency key on the charge

title: feat: invoice job
defect: coalesce=False and max_instances=2 so a slow invoice job overlaps itself and two invoices are issued for one period
missing: at most one invoice job instance may run per period
fix: coalesce=True, max_instances=1, and a DB unique(period, tenant)

title: feat: created_at
defect: pendulum parsing of a spring-forward gap datetime returns a time that never existed and created_at is stored wrong so billing skips the day
missing: gap datetimes must be rejected or shifted with an explicit rule, not silently stored
fix: parse with fold-aware zoneinfo and reject nonexistent local times

title: feat: parse exp
defect: fromisoformat('2026-08-19T12:00:00Z') is treated as naive local so expiry is off by the server offset and sessions die early or late
missing: Z must mean UTC, not naive local
fix: replace Z with +00:00 before fromisoformat, or use a parser that understands Z

title: feat: cron next
defect: croniter on naive local fire times double-fires in the DST fall-back hour so customers get two charge attempts
reach: hourly charge cron on America/New_York boxes
missing: the fall-back hour must produce one fire, not two
fix: compute next fire in UTC (or zoneinfo-aware cron) and store last_fire timestamptz

title: feat: tz localize
defect: tz_localize(ambiguous='infer') picks the wrong side of the fold so a bar close is stamped in the other offset and PnL is wrong
missing: ambiguous minutes must use a deterministic rule (first/last/NaT), not infer
fix: ambiguous='NaT' and drop, or pass an explicit bool array; do not infer

title: feat: make aware
defect: make_aware(dt, is_dst=True) always picks DST so fold-hour appointments collide with the DST instant
missing: is_dst=True must not be hardcoded across a fold
fix: use zoneinfo and require an explicit offset, or reject fold times

title: feat: bio template
defect: ${user.bio | n} disables escaping so a profile bio XSS anyone who views it
missing: user.bio must be escaped
fix: drop | n; default filter escape

title: feat: note safe
defect: user.note.html_safe marks customer HTML safe in the agent inbox
missing: customer notes must be escaped
fix: do not call html_safe on user content; let ERB escape

title: feat: comment raw
defect: @Html.Raw(comment) inserts a stored script into the product page
missing: comments must be encoded
fix: use @comment (encoded); never Html.Raw on user text

title: feat: trust html
defect: bypassSecurityTrustHtml(cms.html) from a merchant CMS executes in the shopper app
missing: merchant HTML must not skip the sanitizer
fix: do not bypass; sanitize with a server allowlist first

title: feat: review html
defect: {@html review.body} executes a stored payload on the PDP
missing: review body must not be {@html}
fix: render as text or sanitize then {@html}
